# ai-governance-audit-chain

> Auditable evidence-chain templates for AI systems, aligned with ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS) and NIST AI RMF: six artifact templates (decision log, risk register, model card, change record, human-oversight proof, incident ledger) + clause mapping + forensics self-check.

An Agent Skill in the SynomosAI ecosystem. Turns the "AI passport / XCGS governance" stance into an auditable, certifiable, externally defensible evidence base.

## Core

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/ai-governance-audit-chain/blob/main/SKILL.md): skill main file (YAML frontmatter + full method and templates)
- [README.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/ai-governance-audit-chain/blob/main/README.md): bilingual overview and quick start
- [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/ai-governance-audit-chain/blob/main/LICENSE.md): MIT
